purpose: Isolated permitted stdlib controls; not a market trial or external package certification

PIT02.hypothesis: Known future filings cannot change earlier panel, conflicts reject, missing data never resurrects old values
PIT02.document_checks: original provenance sha256, reference date, scale, total, treasury and valuation eligibility; 3 fixed public fixtures only, not original 12-document proposal

UNC02.hypothesis: iid standard error undercovers a stationary AR(1) with positive dependence; known covariance oracle calibrates the same DGP
UNC02.seeds: 20260911+i for i=0..499; paired seeds across phi
UNC02.metric: two-sided coverage of zero and Wilson 95% interval
UNC02.criterion: 95% must lie inside Wilson interval; report all, no tuning
UNC02.oracle: exact finite-T AR(1) variance of mean with known phi and innovation variance 1
UNC02.limits: oracle knows DGP; not deployable estimator; arch bootstrap experiment remains separate

RANK02.hypothesis: Relative order need not imply positive executable return
RANK02.fixture: 20 scores j=0..19, return -0.10 + j*0.001; common negative shock
RANK02.criterion: Spearman=1, top5 gross<0, fixed one-way cost0.001 worsens net
RANK02.limits: analytical synthetic falsification, not a comparison of trained ranking and regression models
